title: Platform Wars: Phone vs Desktop
description: A fast cross-platform arena platformer. Phone team uses touch agility; Desktop team uses keyboard precision.

controls.desktop: A/D or arrows to move, W/Space to jump, F to dash
controls.phone: Twin-thumb platformer pad + dash double-tap: left thumb ◀/▶ (double-tap to dash), right thumb ▲ jump / 🔥 fire, tap a platform to ping
